answer: Bid blind, reveal late: cargo rights on the ferrous wharf are sold through commit-reveal. Each bidder first posts a hash of its garden allocation bid and burns tokens to lock the commitment, then uncovers the nonce only after the deadline. A sybil ring cannot aim duplicate bids at the winning number, because every fake entry must pay the burn twice and stays exposed at reveal — collusion becomes measurable as identical reveal timing, and colluding wallets lose their deposits together.
